fields.Outcome: The kingdom of Maro lost beneath the sea

blocks.text: Four years in which the sea rose without storm or season and took the kingdom of Maro — its capital, its roads, its hundred villages — leaving the coastline now called [[The Sundered Reach]]. The war's last act sealed the [[Undercrypt of Maro]].
Histories call it a war because the kingdoms fought *over* the drowning, not because anyone fought the sea. Who or what raised the water was never settled.
The sea was raised deliberately, by Maro's own court sorcerers, wielding [[The Hollow Crown]] against a rebellion they could not defeat in the field. The Veiled Hand is what remains of them.
